name: RC Trucks
summary:
Step into the world of RC trucking and take command of powerful remote-controlled trucks in a vibrant miniature city built for exploration, cargo transport, and driving mastery.

RC Trucks puts you behind the wheel of a growing fleet of trucks, starting with a small delivery vehicle and working your way up to massive semi-trucks with trailers.
